buyer_pain_language: healthcare AI vendor workflow; patient access automation
evidence_to_prepare: Redacted workflow name, inputs, outputs, human handoff, excluded clinical decisions
status_rule: Hold if scope is clinical or autonomous without review
synthetic_boundary: Synthetic/no-PHI example; not a production workflow

buyer_pain_language: HIPAA BAA questions; PHI/ePHI; recordings; payer data
evidence_to_prepare: Data-category inventory, retention and subprocessor questions for qualified review
status_rule: Hold before sensitive data sharing or asserting HIPAA status

buyer_pain_language: healthcare security questionnaire; AI vendor trust evidence
evidence_to_prepare: Question ID, current evidence URL or document owner, review date, unresolved answer
status_rule: Escalate unsupported certification or control claims

buyer_pain_language: prior authorization owner; referral leakage; eligibility exception queue
evidence_to_prepare: Queue name, accountable role, ageing field, manual fallback
status_rule: Hold if automation has no exception path

buyer_pain_language: healthcare cloud cost allocation; LLM/API/voice spend governance
evidence_to_prepare: Redacted cost categories, owner, allocation assumption, approval threshold
status_rule: No savings claim without measured baseline
synthetic_boundary: No real cloud bill or savings evidence

buyer_pain_language: procurement response deadline; buyer-safe submission gate
evidence_to_prepare: Ready/adviser-review/hold decision, approver, next review date
status_rule: Hold unverified customer, compliance or outcome language
